name: Change Management Training
description: Demo credential representing an eight-hour Change Management Training completed in Zürich on 26 August 2025. This demo is not issued by Implement Learning Institute or University of Basel.

achievement.name: Change Management Training
achievement.description: An eight-hour training in practical change management, combining core models, communication, resistance and applied exercises.

criteria.narrative: Completion of the Change Management Training covering the role of a Change Agent, change communication, resistance, Kübler-Ross and Rogers models, feedback, practical application and a holistic approach to change management.
